socketSessions.invalidVariables: Log entry. The variables of the active environment are stored as JSON.
socketSessions.invalidAddress: Log entry. ws:// and wss:// are WebSocket address prefixes and stay as given.
socketSessions.notConnected: Log entry when a message could not be sent because the connection closed.
socketSessions.undefinedVariables: {{names}} is a list of variable names.
socketSessions.reconnecting: Log entry. {{seconds}} is a number of seconds; s is the abbreviation of seconds.
socketSessions.couldNotSend: {{message}} is a technical message in English.
socketSessions.connected: Log entry: the connection is open.
socketSessions.couldNotConnect: {{message}} is a technical message in English.
socketSessions.connecting: {{url}} is the address being connected to.
socketSessions.disconnected: Log entry: the user closed the connection.
